description: Liège - bulles à verre et bulles textiles is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données présente l'emplacement des bulles à textiles des différents organismes sur le territoire liégeois. Vous constatez une dégradation sur cette infrastructure ? Vous pouvez la signaler via le formulaire en ligne "A signaler en rue" sur l' e-guichet ou sur l' appli Liège en poche ou. Coverage: Liège. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are textile, bulle, vêtement, recycler, Terre, Oxfam. The portal shows 68 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2026-09-29 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
